name: Itonaga Akira
source:
Blunt and unfriendly, yet his dance skills are rivaled by none. He's extremely cautious of his surroundings. He acts cold towards women, and always interacts with them with an invisible barrier between them.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hunex_play.ontheqt]Google Play[/url]]
